model_interpretation.claim: With the existing 128-thread blocks and unchanged one-element-per-thread mapping, reduce0 performs seven CTA-wide barriers in its shared-memory tree. Reducing each warp with the existing sync-intrinsic helper, writing one partial per warp, then using one CTA barrier and a warp-0 reduction may reduce synchronization overhead. The tail remains zero-padded and every launched lane participates. The baseline is correct at a mean 47.08 µs; no candidate speedup or correctness is claimed before controller evaluation.

items.subject: Intra-block reduction primitive and synchronization
items.objective: Isolate the cost of reduce0's intra-block shared-memory tree: compare a warp-level reduction using valid CUDA sync intrinsics and a correct inter-warp combination, optionally against an allowed CUB block primitive. Hold global input mapping, block geometry, and pass structure fixed during comparisons. Ensure participating lanes use correct masks and synchronization, including tail blocks. Report correctness and repeated whole-call timings. Preserve a correct modular implementation even if it does not beat the full baseline alone, since it may combine differently with a changed hierarchy; do not claim a combination is faster without measuring it.
